<description>
The test would fail with a large enough timeout factor, because the ipc
times out before the delayed `generate()` call: `template2` would be `None`
and fail the assert.

Also, the test would sleep more than timeout_factor seconds in the happy
case in all test runs.

Fix both issues by sleeping for a bit longer than a single fee tick.
</description>

<commits>
fae567777f test: Rename default_ipc_timeout -> default_ipc_timeout_ms

Functional-test time values are commonly seconds-based, so rename this to clarify it is ms.

faa89b1ae6 test: Speed up interface_ipc_mining.py and fix large timeout-factor bug

The test would fail with a large enough timeout factor, because the ipc
times out before the delayed generate() call: template2 would be None
and fail the assert.

Also, the test would sleep more than timeout_factor seconds in the happy
case in all test runs.

Fix both issues by sleeping for a bit longer than a single fee tick.
Also, use default_ipc_timeout_ms, because a longer timeout is not
needed.
</commits>
